editorial.meta_description: Exam MB-220 for Microsoft Dynamics 365 Customer Insights - Journeys is officially retired and no longer available for candidates to schedule or complete.
editorial.overview: This exam covered the configuration and management of Dynamics 365 Customer Insights - Journeys. Certified by Microsoft, it evaluated skills in segment management, marketing channels, and journey orchestration. This exam is retired, and Microsoft has named no successor. Candidates should review official Microsoft documentation for current certification paths and learning opportunities related to Dynamics 365 applications. The exam consisted of 40 questions and required a passing score of 700 to achieve certification, which remained valid for 1 year.
editorial.who_should_take: This exam was intended for functional consultants responsible for configuring and managing customer journeys. It required experience in Dynamics 365 environments, specifically focusing on segment creation, marketing channel distribution, and event management to support business marketing goals.
editorial.preparation_strategy: Since this exam is retired, you should not prepare for it. Focus your efforts on current Microsoft learning paths for Dynamics 365. Review the official documentation to understand the latest features of Customer Insights - Journeys. Any technical knowledge regarding journey orchestration and segment management remains relevant for professional practice, even though the certification itself is no longer available. Please consult the official Microsoft website to identify active exams that align with your professional goals and current Dynamics 365 skill requirements.

faq.question_title: How many questions were on the exam?
faq.answer_text: The exam consisted of 40 questions in total, which were designed to test the candidate's knowledge of Dynamics 365 Customer Insights - Journeys configuration and management across various functional areas of the application during the active period of the certification.

The passing score for this exam was 700 on a scale of 1-1000. Candidates were required to demonstrate proficiency across all domains to meet this threshold and successfully earn the certification before it was retired by Microsoft from the active catalog.

The exam duration was 100 minutes, providing candidates with sufficient time to complete the various question types, including multiple choice, drag and drop, and case study scenarios that were presented during the testing session for this specific Dynamics 365 certification.

faq.question_title: What was the price of the exam?
faq.answer_text: The exam price was 165 USD, though pricing could vary by region and was subject to change based on local currency and specific Microsoft policies in effect at the time the exam was available for registration and completion by interested professional candidates.

methodology.summary: This editorial was constructed by synthesizing official Microsoft exam guides and documentation to provide a factual summary of the retired MB-220 certification, ensuring all information aligns with the final published objectives and status of the exam.
